name: Cannabis sativa - landrace catalogue
status: 64 landrace populations; one species, all interbreed
notes: Cannabis sativa L. is the single species accepted by Kew POWO; 'indica' and 'ruderalis' are treated here as types, not species. There is no authoritative registry of landraces: these are the regional populations consistently named in ethnobotany (Clarke & Merlin, Cannabis: Evolution and Ethnobotany, 2013) and public landrace lists, each tagged with how well it is attested. Every entry is the SAME species: a landrace is a starting genome for a region, and where two ranges meet, hybrids appear on their own. Loaded like the aroid catalogue (data/plants/*.json). 'cannabis', 'repro' and 'genes' blocks are read by the plant lifecycle/genetics system; the current loader ignores them. flower_trigger gene: 0 = flowers by age (ruderal), otherwise maps to the day length in hours at which flowering starts (12 h + gene * 4 h).

types.broad_leaf: broad-leaf mountain type: short, dense, wide leaflets, often purpling in cold; short autumn flowering
types.narrow_leaf_tropical: narrow-leaf equatorial type: tall, open, thin leaflets; long flowering near the equinox day length
types.narrow_leaf_subtropical: narrow-leaf highland/subtropical type: tall but earlier than the equatorial populations
types.ruderal: ruderal steppe type: small, weedy, flowers by age regardless of day length; disturbed ground, roadsides, middens
types.hemp: temperate fibre/seed type: very tall single stems, little resin, heavy seed
